title: Index of Fire Support Bases and Landing Zones Used in South Vietnam, with Map Sheet Numbers and Coordinates
citation: William Kindred, comp., List of Fire Support Bases (FSB) and Landing Zones (LZ) used in South Vietnam during the Vietnam War [updated January 2023], 525 pp. William Kindred Collection, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 25720204001.
notes: A veteran-compiled gazetteer converting wartime American place names into grid references, latitude and longitude, and 1:50,000 map sheet numbers, each entry citing the unit report it came from. Its Nui Ba Den entries give the Special Forces camp as Detachment A-324 (with A-325A), opened July 1964, at grid XT281582 on map sheet 6231-4, and describe the summit as a Special Forces radio relay. Compiled from unit records rather than being one itself: treat entries as well-sourced secondary data, and cite the underlying report where an entry names one.
